docket_entries.description: FILE DESTROYED PER ORDER SIGNED BY JUDGE SAMUEL FENG ON 12/9/2021 PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 681.53.
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,050.00 FILED BY TAYLOR, BRIGETTE AS TO DEFENDANT SQUARE, INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-27-2018 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL (AGENT FOR SERVICE OF PROCESS:NATIONAL REGISTERED AGENTS, INC.) FILED BY PLAINTIFF TAYLOR, BRIGETTE AS TO DEFENDANT SQUARE, INC.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED JAN-11-2018, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT SQUARE, INC.
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT SQUARE, INC.
ORDER RE: DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF BRIGETTE TAYLOR IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SQUARE INC. IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY ERIC NISTAD, INVESTIGATOR. PLAINTIFF INDICATED ON RECORD THE DEFENDANT SUBSEQUENTLY SINCE CLAIM FILED HAD TRANSFERRED THE MONEY AT ISSUE. JUDGE CECILIA P. CASTELLANOS ASKED PLAINTIFF IF THEY WERE SATISFIED WITH THE RESULT AND WERE WILLING TO DISMISS WITH PREJUDICE ON OPEN RECORD. PLAINTIFF AGREED AND TO AND DISMISSED MATTER WITH PREJUDICE. JUDGE: CECILIA P. CASTELLANOS; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
